plan: Drive: from Heffley Creek, about 93 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5 (Yellowhead Hwy), Old Hwy 5, Hwy 1 and 97 (Trans-Canada Hwy E), Barnhartvale Rd.
Park: 50.22892, -120.05746, where the truck road ends (Douglas Lake Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 4.4 km on Rush Lake by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 140 m NW, climb about 4 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the open slopes and forest edges at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-20, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-03, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-03.
